summary_short: Umm... a pause, a breath, a bridge from thought to word. In the humble umm, a glimpse of the whole mind. This one is for Bryan Dobson.

In moments of thought, where words are sought,
Lies a simple sound, where truths are caught.
‘Um’... a pause, a breath, a quiet space,
Where minds dance and thoughts embrace.

It’s not just a sound, but a silent plea,
For time, for clarity, for the mind to be free.
In the ‘um’, we find a world unseen,
A moment’s break, where we can lean.

So here’s to ‘um’, a simple refrain,
In the symphony of dialogue, it’s not in vain.
For in these pauses, our truths we find,
In the humble ‘um’, a glimpse of the mind.

summary_short: An ode to Liberty. Written when she needed reminding of herself. Inspired by Victor Hugo.

lyrics_head_search:
Glory to you, O Liberty, your boundless temple
Rises in the heavens, built on eternal law!
Man was made to serve you, and in his mighty heart
You must reign as a god, in awe.
Glory to you! Already the shadows flee the sunrise,
Already under distant skies the lightning glows,
And the future, crowned with roaring light,
Rises from the grave where darkness grows.
Rise up, ye naked peoples, slaves of tyrant masters!
Break your chains! The day is bright!
People! To your butchers, to their wicked laws,
Oppose but justice and the sky’s clear light!
Let the storm’s fire ignite your brow with fury!
Let the tempest open your eyes at last!
That in this righteous battle, beneath honest thunder,
Your cry be noble, fierce, and vast!
Ah! What do I see? They rise! O sublime army!
They stand beneath the living flag once more!
And I, standing proud, my soul aflame,
Shall tell the tyrants of the earth... farewell forevermore!

lyrics_head_search:
[Verse 1]
I invite you to join me in this lucid dream,
Butterflies spin in our bloodstream.
Breathe slow, Gulf of Mexico’s gone,
Let’s cheer to stories from a millennium that’s done.

[Pre-Chorus]
Sunburnt lips and a half-priced beer,
Lost in a jukebox atmosphere,
She don’t know yet, but the heat gon’ teach
Down here, "beach" don’t rhyme with "bitch".

[Chorus]
Lolita in Pensacola, singin’ hallelujah in a southern bar room,
Jukebox went poof, wrong time, wrong tune.
She asked out loud, silence, they stared at her speech,
Didn’t know "beach" don’t sound like "bitch".

[Verse 2]
Alligators grin like green kings belong,
Triple K ghosts, Confederate songs...
A postcard world with bigots inside,
Where color dictates who gets to ride.

[Bridge]
She knows it now, the fears, the divide,
The hush that stares when the jukebox dies.
She hums her truth through a bourbon haze,
"Why can’t love be the law these days?"

[Chorus]
Lolita in Pensacola, singin’ hallelujah it’s all absurd,
Askin’ in tongues nobody’s heard.
Trippin’ through prejudice, sweet and strange,
Singin’ "brave hearts don’t see no fear, let’s change." 

[Outro]
Under neon crosses and hurricane lights,
She learns what freedom cost

summary_short: The accordion of ignorance plays itself louder the more you pull it open.
primary_ep_title: The Accordion of Ignorance EP X4
lyrics_head_search:
In the heart of the streets, where truths fall apart,
There’s an accordion tune, a discordant start.
Where reason is quieted, shadowed and dimmed,
And they dance to a beat that’s cruel and grim.

They sing of a man with words like a slap,
With a mouth full of lies and hands that grab.
Yet on and on, they cheer his charms,
Blind to the rage in the world’s open arms.

[Chorus]
Oh, the accordion plays, on loops it sways,
To the tyranny of ignorance, our tragic malaise.
It stutters and wheezes, no sense, no rhyme,
As justice falters, as truth runs out of time.

They tell tales of valor, of victories grand,
While rights are erased by his careless hand.
With a sneer for the weak, he tears apart,
All that we built with wisdom and heart.

And the tune, it shudders, sharp and vile,
A cacophony cloaked in a foolish smile.
They laugh as they stumble, entranced by his spin,
Never seeing the rot that festers within.

[Chorus]
Oh, the accordion plays, relentless and strong,
The rhythm of ignorance, blind and wrong.
A sad, twisted tune, syncopated lies,
Where justice fails, and truth slowly dies.

And the world, it watches, hands thrown in despair,
At a dance so absurd it’s beyond compare.
